answer: Make every identity earn its weight through tenure instead of price: rewards vest over sixty epochs and stay locked while the account keeps answering fresh prompts. A farmer who spins up an island of fakes cannot forge instant income, since each alias must wait, stay coherent, and survive spot audits, so capital is tied up per alias while quartz-clear reputation accrues slowly. Scaling n accounts multiplies locked float and audit exposure by n, and one cluster flagged by auditors makes the whole forge of unvested rewards forfeit.
